outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic illustration of the experimental design, not a plot of data.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b expression shows mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group.
Tumor volume plot shows mean with 95% CI as well as individual data points (dots) for each mouse.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b expression (shRNA) shows mean ± SD with individual data points overlaid.
This is a line plot of tumor volume over time with mean ± SEM error bars; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
CD4 quantification bar chart shows mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) for each field/tumor overlaid on the bars.
pERK quantification bar chart shows mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) for each field overlaid on the bars.
